audit.whatIsWrong: full.diff is EVEN and every phases[].side is 'Skill', but content.win[] (which matches the packet's own levelChart) has Lulu winning 6 of 7 stages. The two layers disagree on who wins almost the whole lane.
audit.why: Poppy has no ranged poke (melee tank/fighter, Hammer Shock range 430) and her only hard engage, Heroic Charge (E), is denied by Polymorph from level 3 on. Content's win[] already reflects this correctly; full's flat 'Skill' chart is the stale layer.
audit.corrected: Flip full.phases[].side to Lulu for L1, L2, L3, L4-5, L6 and 2+ items (First item stays Skill, matching content already). diff moves EVEN -> FAVOURED.

audit.why: Level 6 (Wild Growth vs Keeper's Verdict) and First item (Steadfast Presence grounding vs your shield compounding) are the real spikes and are already named in breakdown.spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Steadfast Presence as matchup-defining but contains no digit anywhere in the field, violating the cooldown-number requirement.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence (W) is 20/18/16/14/12s by rank — a real number turns 'read it before every duo step-up' into an actionable timer.
audit.corrected: Cite the 20s rank-1 / 12s maxed cooldown explicitly.

edits.after: Poppy has no ranged poke — Pix's doubled angle wins every Level 1 trade clean.

edits.before: E-mark trades begin: Pix on the carry makes every auto a volley.
edits.after: E-mark trades widen the gap: Pix volleys punish a melee support who can't answer from range.

edits.before: Polymorph online — their engage now has a 1.5-second hole where a champion used to be.
edits.after: Polymorph shuts down Heroic Charge (E) — silence her mid-dash and the wall-stun never lands.

edits.before: Chip and mark the margins; hold W for the dive their kit is saving up for.
edits.after: Chip continues unanswered; Steadfast Presence (W) only threatens once its 12-20s cooldown is up.

edits.before: Wild Growth online — burst math on your carry dies; the knockup punishes the divers who try.
edits.after: Wild Growth punishes any Keeper's Verdict (R) all-in — the knockup saves your carry from the charge.

edits.before: - Poppy Steadfast Presence: matchup-defining — Stops every dash near her — mobility dies inside the zone. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Whimsy answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Steadfast Presence (W) is 20s at rank 1, 12s maxed — track it before every duo step-up; mobility dies inside the zone while it's up. - Whimsy answers one disaster per cycle. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
